{{Quote|Forty! and you expect the two of us to take them on?!|The job candidate concerns to Ember's offer|<ref name="BH 2" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the early days of the recently formed galactic empire had heard about a job offered by [[Ember Chankeli]] to which he considered signing on. He arrived with Ember short time before [[Dass Jennir]], another candidate. Jennir was curious about what the job actually was exactly, since the offer wasn't very specific, to which Ember responded that it was to take care of a gang problem. When the job candidate asked how many members this gang contained, Ember responded that it was about forty. The job candidate was baffled about the idea of just the two of them taking on so many enemies at once. Jennir on the other hand observed that maybe one could do it instead of two, but before any of the three could get an agreement, they were interrupted by a [[Unidentified Chistori thug|thug]] who Jennir had beaten earlier and his friends. Jennir beat the attackers with ease, meanwhile the job candidate took his chance and ran away.<ref name="BH 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The job candidate appeared in [[2009]] in ''[[Dark Times: Blue Harvest, Part 2]]'' the second of two mini-issues of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series which was designed as an introduction to the [[Star Wars: Dark Times: Blue Harvest|''Blue Harvest'']] story arc. The issue was written by [[Randy Stradley]] under the name Mike Harrison and illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]].<ref name="BH 2" />
